header.name: FallingTree BP [DAMAGE v2.7.3]
header.description: v2.7.3 DAMAGE — fixes missing player damage during tree-fall impact. Previous versions used runCommand('damage @s ...') which silently failed in some engine builds (player-scoped @s binding flaky; peaceful context stripped the cmd). Switched to direct entity.applyDamage() script API which cannot be suppressed by difficulty. Also loosened corridor width 1.2→1.5, along -0.5→trunkLen+1.5, dy -1.5→3, so players clipped by the visible trunk edge still get hit. Added explicit 'impact sweep: N/M in corridor' log line for diagnostics. Tree now damages ANY player in the fall path including the chopper. All other behavior identical to v2.7.2.
